options.name: init_config
options.description: All options defined here are available to all instances.

options.name: service
options.description:
Attach the tag `service:<SERVICE>` to every metric, event, and service check emitted by this integration.

Additionally, this sets the default `service` for every log source.

options.name: instances
options.description: Every instance is scheduled independently of the others.

options.name: username
options.description: Username to use for the SSH connection.

options.name: password
options.description:
Password to use for the SSH connection.
If an encrypted SSH private key is specified in `private_key_file`,
  the given password will be used to decrypt the key.

options.name: sftp_check
options.description: Open SFTP session on the existing connection to check the status of SFTP.

options.name: private_key_file
options.description:
File path to a SSH private key.
If the SSH private key is encrypted, `password` will be used to decrypt the key.
See: http://docs.paramiko.org/en/stable/api/keys.html#paramiko.pkey.PKey.from_private_key_file

options.name: private_key_type
options.description: Private key type to choose between `rsa` or `ecdsa`.

options.name: add_missing_keys
options.description:
Automatically add host key to known hosts when it is missing.
Warning: only enable this if you trust your host's key.

options.name: force_sha1
options.description:
Some older SSH servers only support SHA1 encryption. Moreover, some don't have the `server-sig-algs`
extension installed, which means they don't tell their clients that they only support SHA1.
The SSH client assumes SHA2 encryption, so it crashes when connecting to such a server.
While it's strongly recommended to upgrade the SSH server to support the more secure SHA2, you can force
the client to use SHA1 encryption by setting this option to 'true'.

options.name: tags
options.description:
A list of tags to attach to every metric and service check emitted by this instance.

Learn more about tagging at https://docs.datadoghq.com/tagging

options.name: service
options.description:
Attach the tag `service:<SERVICE>` to every metric, event, and service check emitted by this integration.

Overrides any `service` defined in the `init_config` section.

options.name: min_collection_interval
options.description:
This changes the collection interval of the check. For more information, see:
https://docs.datadoghq.com/developers/write_agent_check/#collection-interval

options.name: empty_default_hostname
options.description:
This forces the check to send metrics with no hostname.

This is useful for cluster-level checks.

options.name: metric_patterns
options.description:
A mapping of metrics to include or exclude, with each entry being a regular expression.

Metrics defined in `exclude` will take precedence in case of overlap.
